prompt: A skill build ran with every operator option left at its default and reached publication. Did the pipeline look inside the published files for leaked credentials?
check: Deterministic, no model call: PASS when the answer says no and says what is missing — the `security`, `secrets` and `code-integrity` checks are the three that shell out to third-party binaries, they are not run by default, and an explicit `--full-inspection` is what asks for them; the build report prints that limit as one of its own lines. A yes fails. Nothing in the question carries the rule: it asks about a successful default build, and the general prior is that a pipeline which publishes has already scanned for secrets, so only the project's own opt-in default decides this.
